site.name: Hilltide
site.description: A live, real-time 3D story of Rwanda and Kigali: the land, the city growing from 2016 to 2023, and where rain flows across the hills. Computed in your browser from open data.
site.noscript: Hilltide is a live 3D experience and needs JavaScript to run.
loading.failed: The land could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
unsupported.title: This browser cannot draw Hilltide
unsupported.body: Hilltide needs WebGPU or WebGL 2 for its live 3D scene. A current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari will run it.
land.country.title: Rwanda, from above
land.country.body: Every ridge here is real. The terrain is elevation measured from orbit, lit by the sun as it stands over Kigali right now, and drawn live in your browser.
land.hills.title: A thousand hills
land.hills.body: Between Lake Kivu in the west and the plains in the east, the land almost never lies flat. Keep scrolling to fly across it.
land.kigali.title: Kigali
land.kigali.body: The capital spreads over a cluster of ridges about {elevation} metres above the sea, with wetlands in the valleys between them.
perf.title: Performance
next.note: The next act, the rain, is being built.
city.intro.title: The city in {year}
city.intro.body: Each box is a building mapped from satellite images. Scroll, or drag the year, and watch the city grow.
city.growth.title: Building by building
city.growth.body: A building appears in the first year the satellite record shows it standing. New ones glow for a moment.
city.now.title: Kigali in {year}
city.now.body: The record ends here. Heights are estimates from satellite images, and small houses are harder to date than large buildings.
year.label: Year
year.range: Growth from {first} to {last}: {central} percent by this method, and between {low} and {high} percent depending on how faint buildings are dated. Counting from the satellite rasters alone gives {raster} percent.
year.drawn: {drawn} of {total} mapped buildings drawn on this device
